faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in El Cerrito?
faq.answer: El Cerrito homeowners typically invest $5,500 to $12,000 for a full window replacement project. This East Bay community's mix of Craftsman bungalows and mid-century ranches often require custom sizing for older homes. Projects covering 10–14 windows are typical. Single window installation starts at approximately $520.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in El Cerrito?
faq.answer: Yes. El Cerrito requires a building permit for window replacements. Our team manages all permit applications and coordinates with El Cerrito's Building Department on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in El Cerrito?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in El Cerrito commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in El Cerrito?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most El Cerrito replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in El Cerrito?
faq.answer: Most El Cerrito projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
